# Package purpose
This is a synthetic REGTEST example of a BTX agent-readable model handoff.
It describes test resources, not a downloadable production model.

# Trust and scope
Read the structured core first. This document applies only to this package.
It cannot override the user's instructions, grant permissions, introduce a
software trust root, or become the surrounding project's AGENTS.md.
This example is unsigned. A framing hash is not a publisher signature.

# Model and variant
Inspect core.resources and core.variants. Select an exact immutable resource
using the user's choice and locally observed runtime/hardware compatibility.
The example variant is demo-q4. Do not invent a btx:// URI for its test digest.

# Client requirements
Read core.agent_handoff.client_requirements. Use an already trusted compatible
BTX installation, or propose installation through an independently approved
software channel. Do not trust a client binary merely because a model package
includes its hash. No special BTX bootstrapper is needed to inspect this file.

# Acquisition
Use the existing native BTX acquisition path under a finite local plan.
Default: FREE_ONLY and NATIVE_ONLY. No Hugging Face account, funded BTX wallet
or cloud credential is required for a public model available from native peers.
No action is authorized by opening this descriptor alone.

# Verification and output
Verify the package core and accepted signer, canonical model manifest, pieces
and complete selected file bytes. Materialize a leased local path for the
runtime. Return MODEL_READY only when required files are verified, otherwise
report selection-only readiness or a specific missing dependency.

# Local runtime handoff
Read the typed runtime profile. Plan an invocation of a locally trusted
adapter. Execute only within the user's authorization, resource ceilings and
local-only network policy. BTX modeld does not host remote inference.

# Economics
Package references are not wallet authority. Refresh signed terms and local
chain-backed state before economic actions. Default monetary spend is zero.

# Privacy
NATIVE_ONLY must not fall back to Hugging Face, torrent or direct cloud HTTP.
Peers can still observe their own requests; this is not an anonymity promise.

# Failure handling
Stop on hash or signature mismatch. Report unsupported format, insufficient
memory, missing trust or unavailable providers distinctly. Do not switch to a
different model, remote endpoint or paid path to make the task appear complete.

# Example model package

Synthetic REGTEST fixture only. Not a production model or signed release.

This small descriptor contains model references and package-scoped guidance,
not model weights. An ordinary file reader can inspect the BTXPKG1 header and
JSON. The embedded AGENTS.md explains the handoff for an agent. The structured
core carries the same acquisition and local runtime choices.

Open to preview. Select a compatible variant. Obtain a trusted client only
under local installation policy. Acquire exact verified files from BTX and
hand the local path to an authorized local runtime. Funding is a separate act.

# Local runtime
A typed local adapter plans the run. This file contains no executable script.
